fieldDescription: If enabled, a number is displayed below each selectable portrait.

Sets the maximum number of selectable characters displayed per row, including their names and portraits.
If your [resolution] is high, consider increasing this value to use the empty space on the right.

Sets the maximum number of selectable portraits displayed per row.
If your [resolution] is high, consider increasing this value to use the empty space on the right.
Choose which portrait gender is shown first when opening the portrait library.

If enabled, portraits from every faction, including hidden factions such as the Remnants, are added to the selection pool.
By default, only the player faction's portrait pool is used.
Allow changing the portraits of all player officers.
Allow changing the portraits of all player-employed human administrators.
Allow changing the portraits of Nexerelin [agents].
Allow changing the portraits of [Alpha Cores] serving as administrators at player colonies.

Allow changing the portraits of certain important people in the main story.

[Only enable this if you know what you're doing - and you're sure you want to.]
Allow changing the portraits, names, and genders of NPCs registered at the planet or station currently being visited.

Allow changing the portraits of people listed in the comm directories of colonies you control.

Requires [SimpleIndustryOptionProvider] to function.
